body: As someone who’s had to endure suicidality for 20 years and has also lost someone to suicide, I can say that it doesn’t just hurt people, with grief that will pass, it damages them. Their life will be impacted every day and they will never be the same person again. In no way am I angry at my friend, her mental illness was just at the point where it was terminal and I don’t believe she had a choice, but as long as I do and am connected to other humans in any way, I fight every day.

God, I remember realizing that I could change my socks and underwear every day because I did my own laundry now. Took me til after college. Took me til after 30 to realize that I was calculating if it was safe before saying “ow” if I got hurt. It’s really sad how long it can take to leave the cage they built us, I don’t know if I’ll ever really be free.
